summary.text: Danielle Duggar is the Republican candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Terri Osborne.
She defeated incumbent Matt Simpson in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary, 51.4 percent to 48.6 percent.

paragraphs.text: Danielle Duggar earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland Global Campus in 2020 and an M.A. from Norwich University in 2022.
Her career experience includes working as an English and reading ACT exam prep teacher and as a legislative assistant and advocacy associate.
Duggar first ran for District 96 in 2022, when Matt Simpson defeated her in the Republican primary, 55.4 percent to 44.6 percent.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Duggar described herself as a Christian believer, wife and mother of three running a grassroots campaign.

She said she opposed vaccine and mask mandates, supported Constitutional Carry and school choice, favored removing the state grocery tax and repealing the 2019 gas tax, and opposed a toll on the I-10 bridge.
